title: E. Screen composition
description: A screen composed by the composer for one user goal, frozen in a version and replayed as is.

generatedFrom.description: The user goal the composer worked from.

^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$.description: The props handed to this Micro-UI; `$ctx.<name>` reads the screen's context.

surface.description: Who acts on this screen: a surface of `surfaces.json` (contract S). The shell sets the caller of every command the screen sends from it, whatever a Micro-UI sent (caller model A); a screen with none, or with one `surfaces.json` does not declare, acts with no role (fail closed).

pilot.description: Another surface the screen acts as while the page's URL carries `<query>=1` (a DM piloting the player's view acts as the DM): the shell's caller is then this surface's. It grants a surface from a URL, which rests on the shell serving loopback only.
